crossRefs.note: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

translations.web: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
translations.bsb: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
translations.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
translations.asv: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
